hook.line: I used to work at PwC's AI factory, building AI agents for the Fortune 500.
hook.visual: Handheld selfie against a clear blue sky, white earbuds, big white 'HOW TO LEARN AI IN 2026' title over his head, small captions on his chest.

beats.what: Title card over the selfie plus a credentials line
He promises five things you need to get into AI
Reassurance: you're still early, it's not too late
Hand gesture as point one starts: take the deeplearning.ai courses
Point two: sign up for a workflow automation tool
Point three: get a Claude Code subscription and run it in the terminal
Gesture as he describes building workflow automations with Claude Code; video ends

why_it_works: Credentials in the first sentence (PwC AI factory) earn the right to give advice
'You're still early' removes the fear of being late, which keeps beginners watching
Loop score 0.917: the single unbroken selfie shot makes the end blend into the start for replays
weaknesses: Promises five things but the video ends after three
Zero cuts in 66 s and no visuals for the tools he names
Loudness -24.5 LUFS, quiet next to other clips
Small captions; 98.1% of text sits outside the safe area
for_robert: Lead with one line of credentials before the list, but avoid his static single shot: give each numbered point a visual (a screen card or Fred holding up the tool's name).
